description: Variant of ``BulkUpdateTagsRequestSerializer`` for resources keyed by UUID (e.g. event definitions).

action.description:
'add' merges with existing tags, 'remove' deletes specific tags, 'set' replaces all tags.

* `add` - add
* `remove` - remove
* `set` - set

ids.description: List of object UUIDs to update tags on.

tags.description: Tag names to add, remove, or set (up to 100 per request, 255 characters each).
